tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: dmag zlog nyer lnga las: bod kyi sgo srung bzhi dang 'phrang srung bzhi'i gtor chog bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: bod khams kha ba can gyi ljongs: mtha' dmag bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir: srung ma gnod sbyin sde brgyad la: sgo srung 'phrang sdom byed par bskos: ma mo brtan ma bcu gnyis po: rgya gar yul gyi mu stegs dang: mtha' dmag sde dgu bsrung bar bskos: brtan ma'i mchod phrin gzhan na gsal: 'dir ni sde brgyad mchod gtor bstan: ྈྈྈ

de la rin po che'i snod brgyad dam gcig gi nang du: gra 'phying gtsang ma'i steng du phye mar dang gser skyems lha sha lag g.yas mda' dar dang me long zas sna gtsang ma 'o ma chu gtsang rnams bshams/mchan/ dbus su thang lha la gnyan gtor gru bzhi: mdun du dmu bshos lug nag snying dang 'bras lug gis brgyan pa: g.yas su bag phye la dkar gsum mngar gsum klu sman btab pa'i klu bshos: rgyab tu bdud bshos la nam mkha' dkar po phug ron gyi sgro'am spu g.yu dang rgyang bu dkar po yungs dkar gang bus brgyan pa: g.yon du spyi la 'brang rgyas mar gyis byugs pa: zur bzhir 'phrang srung bzhi la bshos bu ldem bzhi dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa: skyu dang kha zas ma rmas pa sna tshogs kyis spras la sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs la: gzhan yang 'og nas 'byung ba'i mchod rdzas ci 'byor pa bshams: shing sna gtsang ma'i bsang dang spos dkar gyi du ba 'thul zhing: dar 'phyar rol mo dang bcas te rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis spyan 'dren pa ni:

hūm̐ bh+yo: gling mchog dzam gling sog kha'i gling: rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs ngos: 'phags pa'i zhing khams kha ba can: ri mtho sa gtsang bsil ba'i gnas: spu rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams na: srid pa'i lha chen mthu bo che: sku lha thang lha ya zhur dang: ral pa spyi ring dmu yi rje: klu rgyal sbrul mgo dgu pa dang: bdud kyi rgyal po khram kha na: bod kyi sgo srung chen po bzhi: btsun mo sras dang blon 'khor bcas: ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: 'phrang srung chen po khram sta re: gnod sbyin stag lug chu srin mgo: mkha' 'gro chen mo stag gdong ma: khyab 'jug rak+sha mdung thogs te: 'phrang pa gnod sbyin pho mo bzhi: mched dang btsun mo sras 'khor bcas: ma lus gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: gtsang ma chab kyis sku khrus gsol: oṃ dzaḥdzaḥnā ga rā dzi phu: du ra ya ra ra ya sa ya tsaṇ+ṭa phaṭa mā ra ya bh+yo dzaḥdza:
zhes bkug:
e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: yaṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: raṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: laṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: baṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: e yaṃ raṃ laṃ baṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe a a swā hā:
zhes bzlas pa'i chus khrus gsol:

khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni: gzugs mdzes yid 'ong du mas mchod: sgra snyan rol mo glu yis mchod: dri zhim spos kyi dud pas mchod: ro mchog brgya ldan bcud kyis mchod: 'jam 'khril dar gyi na bza' dang: rang rang dgyes pa'i gos kyis mchod: dngos 'byor yid las byung ba yi: lha dang mi yi yo byad tshogs: tshang zhing yid du 'ong bas mchod: shing bdud rtsi can gyi dud pas bsang: gser lo 'bar ba'i stag pas bsang: g.yu lo 'bar ba'i shug pas bsang: dung lo 'bar ba'i mkhan pas bsang: mchong lo 'bar ba'i ba lus bsang: dri bza' spos dkar dud pas bsang: phur mong lha shing rtsi shing dang: shing sna gtsang ma'i dud pas bsang: sman sna gtsang ma'i dud pas bsang: ma bsang ba rnams bsang gyur cig: ma dag pa rnams dag gyur cig: bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs: bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thul:
de nas srog sngags (
oṃ dzaḥdzaḥnā ga rā dzi phu: du ra ya ra ra ya sa ya tsaṇ+ṭa phaṭa mā ra ya bh+yo dzaḥdza:
)kyi mthar
a kā ro
btags pas gtor ma bsngos la:

hūm̐: sgo ba 'phrang pa khyed rnams kyi: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba ni: phyi mchod rin chen sna lngas bskang: nang mchod dbang po rnam lngas bskang: gsang mchod dza gad bdud rtsis bskang: sman sna stong dang chu sna stong: shing thog me tog 'bru sna stong: dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsi'i chu: g.ya' chu gangs chu gtsang ma dang: 'brang rgyas mdzes pa'i zhal dkar dang: phye mar 'o skol mchod pa 'bul: mchod pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang: spos dang me tog snang gsal dang: zhal zas spyan gzigs sna tshogs dang: ri rab gling bzhi 'dod yon lnga: nam mkha' dar gyis mchod pa dang: le brgan sna lnga'i mda' dar dang: 'phan dang lda ldis thugs dam bskang: sil snyan glu gar rol mo dang: rnga dang g.yer kha ting ting shag: dung dang rdza rnga pi waṃ sogs: snyan pa'i sgra yis thugs dam bskang: gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di: 'dod yon lnga yi sprin phung 'phro: 'don rgu sna tshogs 'byung ba yang: nam mkha'i khams rnams bkang nas 'bul: thugs dam gnyan po skangs gyur cig: gser skyems g.yu skyems gtsang mas mchod: dgra bo'i sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: rin chen khang bzang mchod pa 'bul: rta dang ra lug mchod pa 'bul: bzhon pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang: 'bri dang g.yag dang mdzo dang drel: phyugs kyi khyu rnams mchod pa 'bul: dar dang zab kyi mchod pa 'bul: mdor na lha mi'i 'jig rten na: mkho rgu'i yo byad ci mchis pa:

mdzes rgus brgyan te snyan rgus bstod: bzang rgus bkang ste mchod par 'bul: rgyan ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang: 'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel dang: dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang: yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod: khyad par bod kyi rgyal khams 'di: yongs su bsrung bar mdzad nas kyang: mtha' yi dmag rnams bsrung ba dang: rang gnas dge bar bzhugs su gsol: sgo ba rnams kyis sgo sdoms shig: 'phrang pa rnams kyis 'phrang srungs shig: bod 'di bcol lo thub par srungs: mtshams chod sa gzhi bcing bar mdzod: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang: sngon gyi zhal bzhes las rnams grub par mdzod:
ces brjod cing srog sngags ci nus bzla'o/ gong gi spyan 'dren gyi mjug gi sngags de yin no// mchan/ slar yang mchod pa bsdus pa phul la bka' bsgos: bstod pa bya ba ni:

hūm̐: srid pa'i lha chen ya zhur thang lha gnyan: dkar po 'od 'bar sba lcag shel phreng 'dzin: lha rta ngang dkar 'chibs nas bstan pa srung: rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: dmu rnams yongs kyi rje btsan mthu bo che: ral pa spyi ring rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi bdag: dmu zhags 'dom dgu dang ni ral gri phyar: bstan srung drag po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: klu yi rgyal po chen po mthu stobs can: mgo dgu sbrul gyi ral pas stong khams khyab: dam nyams dgra la pho lhog hur thums 'beb: sbrul nag zhags pas dgu sde 'ching la bstod: hūm̐: bdud rgyal nag po chen po khram kha na: 'jigs pa'i gnod sbyin khram bam thod dbyug 'dzin: mtha' mi gdug pa'i dmag tshogs khram la 'debs: dgra bo'i gshed ma chen po khyod la bstod: hūm̐: bod khams gling dgu srid pa las kyi sa: bde gshegs thub pa'i bstan pa gnas pa'i yul: byang phyogs sgo bzhi srung ba'i mthu bo che: 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan khram sta re: gnod sbyin 'jigs pa'i 'khor tshogs mang pos bskor: phyag mtshan khram bam s+t+wa res dgra srog gcod: 'jigs byed chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: dregs pa'i gtso bo mdung dmar ral gri can: stag gdong kha gdangs dgra bgegs hab kyis 'dren: lug gdong 'jigs pas dgra sde rmongs byed cing:

chu srin kha nas dug gtong khyod la bstod: hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro nag mo mthu mo che: gri gug thod pas dgra bo'i snying khrag len: 'jigs pa'i zhal gdangs stag gdong dgra la rngams: sha za nag mo khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: bdud dang srin po 'dus pa'i drag rtsal can: rak+sha thod phreng rngam pa'i mche ba gtsigs: mdung dmar zhags pas dgra bgegs srog rgyun chod: srid pa'i srog bdud nag mo khyod la bstod: dzam gling byang phyogs bod yul kha ba can: bstan pa yul khams bsrung bar gnyer gtad pa: mthu chen rtsal ldan 'phrang srung pho mo bzhi: 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bdag bstod do: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs pa'i: mthun rdzas 'dod yon sprin phung 'di bzhes la: thub pa'i bstan pa yun du gnas bya'i phyir: mtha' dmag bsrung ba'i las 'di khyod kyis sgrubs:
ces bstod do: de nas phrin las bcol ba ni:

hūm̐: kyai: dgongs shig sgo ba 'phrang pa rnams: 'dod yon mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bod kyi yul khams bsrung ba yi: las 'di rtag tu khyod kyis sgrubs: bskal pa tha ma'i sems can la: khyod kyis srung skyob mi byed na: dang po byang lam bar pa ru: dpal chen phyag na rdo rje yis: srog snying gzir pa mi dran nam: bar du bsam yas has po rir: dbang chen pad+ma he ru kas: dbang du bsdus pa mi dran nam: ri bo bkra bzang rtse mo ru: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis: lha srin thams cad bkug nas ni: dam tshig phog pa mi dran nam: tha mar slob dpon pad+ma yis: spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas ni: a mri ta ni lce la bzhag: bstan pa'i dgra rnams gzhom pa dang: mtha' mi yong ba dgag pa dang: thog dang kha char ser ba yis: dgra sde 'dul bar bya ba dang: sgo srung 'phrang rnams bsdam pa dang: rtag par dus rnams thams cad du: bod kyi yul 'di srungs shig ces: bka' bsgos dam la btags pa rnams: dus 'di nyid du dran par mdzod: sgo ba rnams kyis sgo sdoms shig: 'phrang pa rnams kyis 'phrang srungs shig: mtshams gcod mtha' dmag ma gtang zhig: sngon gyi tha tshig rjes dgongs la: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: rjes su 'jug pa'i sngags 'chang dang: chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: lha rgyud chags pa'i rje 'bangs rnams: mtho mtho dgung la reg pa dang: dma' dma' bu bzhin skyong ba dang:
ru bzhi bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir: mtha' dmag nam yang ma gtang bar: dus kun du ni bsrung bar mdzod:
ces gtor ma dang 'o ma gser skyems g.ya' chu gangs chu dang bcas te byang phyogs kyi nam mkha'i mthongs su mchod la:
badz+ra sa ma ya gats+tsha:
sa gshegs su gsol: srung ma mchod pa la brtson na bod 'dir bkra shis shing mtha' dmag thub bo: srung ma'i mchod thabs slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa rdzogs so:
ldan ma rtse mang gis yi ger bris nas gter du sbas pa ma 'ongs bod yul bstan srung snying rje can dang 'phrad par shog: ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈ
bdag 'dra 'od gsal sgyu mas shog ser las dag par phab pa'o/// /
